thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Paging on-call: multiple DNS timeouts observed in eu-west-2 over the last 3m. Affects internal service discovery (consul -> coredns). See alert: https://alerts.redwood.example/ALRT-9921

alice.chen: Acked. I'll take triage. Any customer-facing impact?

support-bot: We've had a spike in 502/504s for inbound hosted API in eu-west-2 starting ~21:05UTC. Some customers reporting slow responses, intermittent failures.

raj.patel: Oncall networking — seeing BGP peer flaps between AZ-b and AZ-c in eu-west-2 from probe telemetry. Could be causing control plane partitions for consul.

miguel.soto: Consul telemetry shows leader churn in the eu-west-2 datacenter: "leader removed" events every ~30-60s. That would cause SRV lookup failures while servers re-elect. Logs: ```time="2026-03-15T21:05:12Z" level=warn msg="leader removed" node=consul-2```

alice.chen: Confirmed: CoreDNS pods are getting bursts of NXDOMAIN and SERVFAIL when hitting consul catalog backend. Sample log: ```2026-03-15T21:05:34Z ERROR plugin/dns: lookup _service._tcp.svc.consul: i/o timeout```

raj.patel: Network team: the BGP flaps look limited to one AZ transit switch (eu-west-2c). We're seeing route withdraws then rapid re-announce. Could be noisy fabric causing TCP sessions to break to consul servers in that AZ.

netops-team: We have a ticket opened with cloud provider. Initial mitigation: blackhole the flapping transit port for eu-west-2c to force traffic through alternate AZ fabric. Rolling now. 

alice.chen: Mitigation plan while netops acts: 1) reduce CoreDNS reliance on consul for SRV lookups by enabling local cache TTL bump 2) scale CoreDNS replicas to absorb request retries 3) temporarily route internal discovery to standby consul servers in AZ-a/b only.

miguel.soto: Executing #2: kubectl -n infra scale deploy coredns --replicas=6. Logs show extra pods coming up.

raj.patel: For #3, adding node affinity to prefer consul servers in AZ-a/b for the consul client config via configmap patch: ```kubectl patch configmap consul-client -n infra --patch '{"data":{"prefer_az":"a,b"}}'``` Rolling clients should pick it up in ~30s.

support-bot: Customer impact note: CDN-backed endpoints unaffected. Only dynamic service discovery calls inside eu-west-2 that depend on SRV lookups show elevated errors. Incidents page updated: https://incidents.redwood.example/INC-5243

alice.chen: Quick health check after scale and route change: internal request latency down from 900ms->120ms, SRV error rate dropped from 18% -> 2% in last 2 minutes. Still watching. :thumbsup:

miguel.soto: Provider acknowledges fabric instability in eu-west-2c and reports active mitigation. They recommended leaving our blackhole in place until their fix lands.

raj.patel: I'll keep BGP withdraw in place for now. Also increasing consul RPC timeouts to tolerate intermittent packet loss: ```consul config set - <<EOF
{"retry_join":[], "rpc_timeout":"15s"}
EOF```

alice.chen: Starting handoff to night on-call in 30m. @miguel.soto can you prepare a short incident summary and add runbook links? Also set a page rule if degradation returns.

miguel.soto: Will do. Draft summary: "eu-west-2 internal discovery degraded due to AZ fabric BGP flaps causing consul leader churn and CoreDNS cache thrash. Mitigation: isolated flaky transit, scaled CoreDNS, prefer consul servers in AZ-a/b, bumped consul timeouts. Impact: elevated SRV/DNS errors for internal discovery; customer-facing 502/504s reduced after mitigation. Next steps: provider patch for fabric, review consul HA across AZs, add client-side circuit breaker for discovery calls." I'll paste final in 10m.

deploy-bot: Deploy complete: coredns scaled to 6 replicas (revision 3).

support-bot: Noted ~12 customer tickets opened during the window. Tier 2 triage assigned.

alice.chen: Last check: metrics stable for 10m, error rate under 1.5%. We'll keep monitoring for an hour. If provider reports full fix, we'll revert BGP blackhole and observe for recurrence. Handing to on-call: @raj.patel.

raj.patel: Taking over. I'll be primary until 23:30UTC. If error rate >3% or consul restarts >3 in 10m, page the SRE rotation.

incident-bot: Incident status changed to "mitigated" by alice.chen at 2026-03-15T21:22:10Z. Severity downgraded to SEV-3. Logs and timeline: https://incidents.redwood.example/INC-5243/timeline

miguel.soto: Final note: we should add a proactive runbook item to circuit-break retry loops that hit SRV failures — lots of services pile up retries causing outage amplification. I'll add a ticket after postmortem. :memo:
